checks.name: load_monotonicity
checks.findings: Increasing load (relative to fixed capacity) must never increase a target's score.

checks.name: latency_monotonicity
checks.findings: Increasing observed latency must never increase a target's score.

checks.name: cost_monotonicity
checks.findings: Increasing a target's configured cost, relative to a fixed rival, must never increase its score.

checks.name: cold_start_neutrality
checks.detail: bad=0.020 cold=0.500 good=0.990 (want bad < cold == 0.5 < good)
checks.findings: An unobserved target must score exactly neutral (0.5) on latency -- worse than a good observed target, better than a bad observed one, never automatically winning or losing the way EWMA's optimistic cold-start rule (proven to cause lock-in in Experiment 006-B) would.

checks.name: staleness_collapses_to_neutral
checks.findings: Once a target's data is stale, its score must fall back to neutral regardless of whether the untrusted underlying estimate was good or bad -- old information is never treated as current truth, the direct fix for the staleness blind spot Stage 3/6 demonstrated in EWMA.

checks.name: cache_affinity_specificity
checks.detail: edge-a on key-x=1 (want 1), edge-b on key-x=0 (want 0), edge-a on key-y=0 (want 0)
checks.findings: Cache affinity must contribute only for the exact target that last served the exact key -- never for a different target on the same key, never for the same target on a different key.
